title: I Used the Festival Wristband Policy on the Volunteer Coordinator

parts.text: I volunteered six hours in the heat for a wristband that said ALL WEEKEND. At 6:40 p.m. the coordinator, Brett, scanned me out of my own shift and said volunteers re-enter through guest lines after 6. The guest line was ninety minutes. I was twenty-one, sunburned, holding a radio they still wanted me to carry tomorrow. The volunteer FAQ said weekend bands skip guest lines. I photographed the FAQ, the band, the time. Then Brett's friends walked through the staff gap with no bands at all.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: His friends are using the staff gap while I am being sent to a ninety-minute guest line.

social.video_title: They sent volunteers to the guest line and waved friends through — Part 1/2
social.description: Six hot hours, ALL WEEKEND ink, a radio for tomorrow. Friends without bands. Would you have argued at the gap?

parts.text: I found the festival ops lead and showed the FAQ. Brett's friends got guest-lined. My band worked at the staff gap like the print said. I drank water that tasted like plastic and heaven. Tomorrow I still carried the radio. Brett coordinated from a chair. The FAQ stayed on the volunteer drive. Heat is easier when the ink on your wrist is honest.

social.video_title: Ops sent the friends to the line they invented for me — Part 2/2
social.description: Staff gap restored, water, radio. Was a friend a wristband?
